purpose: Test ERV first, followed by EO carrying the full remaining dehumidification duty to the supply humidity ratio.
interpretation: The energy window is an all-in EO SEC budget. The membrane sweep is a conditional finite-film transport calculation. Neither is a validated full-system saving claim.

targets.label: O50 reference at 32 C
targets.interpretation: The passive ERV outlet is already drier than O50 in absolute humidity, so EO has no post-ERV O50 duty.

targets.label: 10 percent post-ERV reduction
targets.interpretation: Regression bridge to the released 10 percent post-ERV study.

targets.label: O30 humidity ratio at 32 C
targets.interpretation: EO polishing from the passive ERV outlet to the O30 absolute-humidity coordinate.

targets.label: Full remaining latent duty
targets.interpretation: EO removes all remaining moisture down to the 20 C and 50 percent RH supply humidity ratio; the downstream coil is sensible-only in the screening model.

endpoint_control_audit.interpretation: Tests the saturated-coil to sensible-only control-regime discontinuity at the exact supply humidity coordinate.

transport_sweep.receiver_capacity_axis_interpretation: Capacity-only sensitivity. Receiver film coefficients and the released area-based fan law remain frozen; extra receiver-flow fan/manifold energy is not modelled and cases are not rankable across this axis.
transport_sweep.external_receiver_source_interpretation: Ratios above one require an additional declared receiver-air source beyond the balanced ERV exhaust. Its conditioning, fan and disposal energy are not modelled.
transport_sweep.current_density_policy: sampling coordinate only; no acceptance cap

missing_or_parameterized_terms: conjugate membrane and air thermal feedback
